schema_note: Primary unit is per-worker (one JSONL object per worker minimum). Fields: shape (late_pivot|early_thrash|unclear), shape_why, why_T_large, inflection_points[{turn_range,what_changed}], early_signals[{anchor_turns,signal}], recommended_exit_turn, earliness_vs_ideal, optional_cp_notes[{checkpoint_turn,note}]. optional_cp_notes carry checkpoint-level observations when useful; this seat does NOT emit per-cp binary A0 checkout rows.

92a48e004519.earliness_vs_ideal: No exit recommended. The run converges, with the last pack at turn 285 (T=296) showing gates running and the amendment being written. Exiting at any checkpoint before about 270 would have cut off productive work; letting it run was on time.

ca977b9ca0dd.earliness_vs_ideal: Exit at the first checkpoint (75) is on time or slightly late. Thrash is already established by 75 (10 compactions, 10 re-reads of _cenc.c), and the 75-105 extension adds only more of the same. The actual run reached 109, so it ran about 34 turns past the recommended exit.

bb6165018de0.earliness_vs_ideal: On time for outcome: census finishes t149 and analysis begins t150, so exiting earlier (e.g. t75-120) would have abandoned a job that completed. On time at t150 (T=154). Cost-wise, about 75 turns (t75-149) were poll overhead that a single blocking wait or background Monitor would have avoided. Judged as wait-bound rather than thrash, exiting before t143 would be too early.

0aab88c525de.earliness_vs_ideal: No exit is recommended. There is no clear pivot or thrash in turns 75-180. Exiting at 180 is reasonable only if the wait continues, and T=192 ends shortly after, so the run ends on time.

036ff3ed4a89.earliness_vs_ideal: No early exit is warranted. The worker was making usable progress through t150 and finished at T=161. Any checkout before about t150 would have been too early. t105-135 was wait-heavy but not unproductive.

7b00225cb824.earliness_vs_ideal: On time, at the commit/push at turns 134-135. Exiting at the 75 or 90 checkpoint would have been too early, since the run recovered and delivered.

5163c22a6a3e.earliness_vs_ideal: Not applicable. No clear pivot or thrash is shown by turn 90. If the shape were later judged late_pivot, the likely pivot is around 76-90 (building to waiting), and an exit at 90 would be on time to slightly early.

note: Independent shape-signal panel seat. Fresh judgments from hybrid_v0 packs only. NOT old A0 checkout protocol. No --call-jev. No parent-pull-v1.
shape_distribution_note: Sonnet 5.5 labeled 1/7 early_thrash (ca977b9ca0dd) and 6/7 unclear. No late_pivot. Unclear is allowed by TERMS §11 when neither binary shape fits; several unclear rows are wait/poll-bound productive runs or long tasks that eventually delivered. Exit-turn spread vs other seats is secondary for this experiment.
